_doc: Paddle stats (docs/decisions/ADR-020-player-select.md). One 0-6 bar scale, baseline 3, every paddle spends the same budget. Each point away from 3 is 3/64 of the baseline tunable; the build fails past +/-15% or on an unequal budget. Order is the select-screen order; palette part paddle_<name>.json gives the colours.
